purpose: Prospective full supported-domain comparison of native signed-spin fundamental 220 QNM interpolation against every applicable row of Cook's independent author archive. The archive is an external validation oracle and is never a runtime or training asset.
comparison_rule: Use every author row with 0 <= spin <= 0.9999 in both datasets; compare corotating to positive signed spin and counterrotating to negative signed spin. Columns 0, 1, -2 are spin, positive frequency and positive damping. No fitting or subsampling.
